milestones.title: Backend foundation and fixed contracts
milestones.description:
Freeze the interoperable data model and run a single Rust HTTP process backed by embedded SQLite.

Completion gate: Fresh checkout builds, migrates an empty database, starts, and passes contract and database tests. Public record publication remains disabled until an owned NSID namespace is recorded.

milestones.title: AT Protocol sign-in and secure sessions
milestones.description:
Authenticate existing accounts on external PDSs using AT Protocol OAuth and establish secure application sessions.

Completion gate: A browser sign-in against a controlled external test PDS succeeds; refresh, sign-out, and negative security cases pass. No app passwords are required.

milestones.title: Scrobble publishing and listening history
milestones.description:
Accept authenticated scrobbles, publish them to the user's own PDS, and expose reliable paginated listening history.

Completion gate: Create, retry, list, and delete a scrobble through the application and verify the corresponding external PDS record, including recovery after interrupted writes.

milestones.title: Federated indexing and AT Protocol feed
milestones.description:
Index music records published outside this application and serve a deterministic music feed from verified AT Protocol repository events.

Completion gate: A second independent writer publishes on another PDS; its records appear without calling this application's write API, and updates/deletes/reconnect/backfill behave correctly.

milestones.title: Music statistics, profiles, and follows
milestones.description:
Provide the core Last.fm-style read experience: profiles, listening totals, top tracks/artists/albums, and a following feed.

Completion gate: Two accounts can follow/unfollow, browse each other's history, and see correct all-time and rolling-window statistics after remote updates and deletions.

milestones.title: Deployable self-contained backend and operational safety
milestones.description:
Release the single-binary backend with static asset serving, health/metrics, backups, resource limits, and repeatable deployment instructions.

Completion gate: Release executable runs with one persistent data directory and public HTTPS termination; backup/restore and failure recovery pass, with live federation/OAuth evidence recorded.

milestones.title: Preact SPA and integrated product MVP — lower priority
milestones.description:
Implement the browser experience after the backend acceptance gate, using the frozen API contracts and embedded release assets.

Completion gate: A browser user can sign in, submit a scrobble, browse feeds/profiles/history/stats, follow/unfollow, delete their scrobble, export data, and sign out on the packaged binary.

issues.body:

- None

Choosing a domain for the owner; public writes with a placeholder namespace; implementing endpoints.

Follow docs/planning/MVP.md. Add tests for the observable behavior listed above. Document configuration and public API changes. Do not substitute mocks for the integration evidence required by this issue.

issues.title: [M1.3] Implement SQLite schema, migrations, and repositories
issues.body:
## Coordination scope
[M1.3] Implement SQLite schema, migrations, and repositories has been decomposed into 4 implementation units. Do not implement this broad issue directly.

## Complete the actual linked subissues
- [ ] M1.3.1
- [ ] M1.3.2
- [ ] M1.3.3

## Original requirements retained
## Deliverable
Add embedded forward migrations and typed storage operations for users, OAuth sessions, scrobbles, follows, feed cursors, ingestion checkpoints, and pending PDS writes. Enable WAL, foreign keys, a five-second busy timeout, and a single serialized writer queue.

## Out of scope
PostgreSQL, Redis, search servers, and destructive down migrations.

## Original requirements retained
## Deliverable
Resume from durable relay cursors with jittered backoff, detect stale cursor/gaps, and reconcile known repositories through verified repository sync. Backfill a DID on first application discovery or first matching stream event; expose indexing status.

issues.body:

## Original requirements retained
## Deliverable
Limit API bodies to 64 KiB, authenticated mutation requests to 60/minute per DID, and unauthenticated API reads to 120/minute per client IP with bounded limiter state. Expose internal metrics for ingestion lag, queue depth, PDS failures, and database health.

## Dependencies
- M4.2
- M5.4

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Oversized body yields 413; exceeded limits yield 429 with Retry-After; tests exercise the limits.
- [ ] Metrics bind to loopback by default or require an operator token; logs redact cookies, OAuth codes/tokens, DPoP keys, and listening payloads.
- [ ] Unavailable PDS/relay causes queued operations or visibly stale feeds rather than data loss or indefinite request hangs.
- [ ] On a stated 2-vCPU/2-GiB Linux benchmark with 100,000 scrobbles, indexed history/feed requests meet p95 under 300 ms at ten requests/second; report measurements and query plans.

## Out of scope
Global DDoS mitigation, multi-node clustering, analytics telemetry, and invented performance passes.

Limit API bodies to 64 KiB, authenticated mutation requests to 60/minute per DID, and unauthenticated API reads to 120/minute per client IP with bounded limiter state. Expose internal metrics for ingestion lag, queue depth, PDS failures, and database health.

- M4.2

- [ ] Unavailable PDS/relay causes queued operations or visibly stale feeds rather than data loss or indefinite request hangs.
- [ ] On a stated 2-vCPU/2-GiB Linux benchmark with 100,000 scrobbles, indexed history/feed requests meet p95 under 300 ms at ten requests/second; report measurements and query plans.

## Out of scope
Global DDoS mitigation, multi-node clustering, analytics telemetry, and invented performance passes.

[M7.4] Embed production SPA assets and run the complete MVP journey has been decomposed into 3 implementation units. Do not implement this broad issue directly.

## Complete the actual linked subissues
- [ ] [[M7.4.1] Build and embed production SPA in release executable](https://github.com/junepark678/atproto_music/issues/119)
- [ ] [[M7.4.2] Run complete browser journey against packaged executable](https://github.com/junepark678/atproto_music/issues/120)
- [ ] [[M7.4.3] Run accessibility and live product release gate](https://github.com/junepark678/atproto_music/issues/121)

## Original requirements retained
## Deliverable
Extend release CI to build web assets before the Rust embedding step. Run Playwright against the packaged executable, add keyboard/accessibility checks, and perform one live browser OAuth/federation journey on dedicated test identities.

## Dependencies
- M7.2
- M7.3
- M6.4

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] One downloadable executable serves the built SPA and backend with no Node runtime or adjacent asset folder; all deep links and hashed assets work.
- [ ] Browser journey covers sign-in, submit/retry, global/remote/following feed, profile, stats, follow/unfollow, delete, export, disconnect, and sign-out.
- [ ] No serious or critical automated accessibility violations on the required screens; keyboard-only journey passes.
- [ ] Record real external-PDS live results separately from fixture tests; close the product MVP only after every milestone gate passes.

## Out of scope
Building optional playback, recommendation, import, or mobile features to delay the MVP.

## Required conventions
Follow docs/planning/MVP.md. Add tests for the observable behavior listed above. Document configuration and public API changes. Do not substitute mocks for the integration evidence required by this issue.

## Closure rule
Every linked child must be merged with the named test cases executed. Preserve all original acceptance requirements and milestone gates; child issues narrow execution, not product scope.

## Refined execution contract
Implement the linked lowest-level tasks only. Their named test matrices and exact file ownership narrow implementation choices. Parent issues close only when every child and original required gate is complete.

[Deterministic test protocol](https://github.com/junepark678/atproto_music/blob/master/docs/planning/TESTING.md)

issues.body:

Use schema version 1 and fixture-only com.example.atmusic. Configure ATMUSIC_LEXICON_PREFIX; publishing must require an owner-controlled non-fixture reverse-domain prefix. Record ownership evidence in the ADR, never infer it from a handle.

## File ownership
docs/adr/0001-namespace.md; crates/core/src/namespace.rs

## Dependencies
- None

Use the named cases below as regression test identifiers. Each must assert the observable result and side effects, not merely status or helper success.

| Case | Input / action | Exact expected outcome |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fixture_namespace` | prefix=com.example.atmusic and publication requested | fail before any HTTP call with namespace_not_production |

Implement executable automated tests in the owning Rust crate (or web/ for SPA tasks), using the fixture/clock/HTTP harness in TESTING.md. Run the exact test target and the workspace checks. A table in documentation without executed tests does not close this issue.
